verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware security key with an official CLI and firmware ecosystem, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no mention of any MCP server, first-party or otherwise. The only agent-related artifact is solokeys.com's llms.txt, which is a Shopify platform-generated shopping-agent file. That is a host-platform feature, not a product capability, and it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
